entities.summary: David Bing is an American former professional basketball player, businessman and politician who served as the 74th mayor of Detroit, Michigan from 2009 to 2014. He is a member of the Democratic Party. Dave Bing was a performers & entertainers from Washington, D.C. (b. 1943-11-24, Washington, D.C.). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to economic history and geopolitics.
